title: Cancellation, Refund and Renewal Figures for Bridgewell Closing Plans
content:
The figures that govern buyer cancellations, refunds and the direct renewal offer on the Real Estate Service Contracts plans are set per plan as follows.

| Plan | Free-look period (calendar days after the closing date) | Administrative fee after the free-look period | Refund processing period (calendar days after a buyer cancellation) | Direct renewal offer (calendar days before the buyer term end) | Homeowner tier offered on conversion |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Closing Starter | 30 | $50.00 | 30 | 60 | Bridgewell HomeCare Bronze |
| Bridgewell Closing Standard | 30 | $50.00 | 30 | 60 | Bridgewell HomeCare Silver |
| Bridgewell Closing Plus | 30 | $50.00 | 30 | 60 | Bridgewell HomeCare Gold |
| Bridgewell Closing Premier | 30 | $50.00 | 30 | 60 | Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum |
| Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year | 30 | $50.00 | 30 | 60 | Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum |
| Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year | 30 | $50.00 | 30 | 60 | Bridgewell HomeCare Silver |

## What each figure is

- **Free-look period**: the calendar days after the closing date within which a buyer cancellation receives the free-look refund.
- **Administrative fee**: the fee deducted from a buyer's pro-rata refund after the free-look period.
- **Refund processing period**: the calendar days after a buyer cancellation within which the refund is issued.
- **Direct renewal offer**: the calendar days before the buyer term end on which the direct renewal offer is issued.
- **Conversion tier**: the Homeowner Service Contracts tier offered on conversion, by its official tier name.

## Points of reading

- The four day counts and the administrative fee are identical on all six plans; only the conversion tier differs.
- The Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year plan converts to Bridgewell HomeCare Silver, the same tier as the Bridgewell Closing Standard plan.
